title: Locker 9 (laundry)
solvedText: The locker opens. Inside, wrapped in a laundry tag, is a thin band with a note: PUT THIS ON. You do, and your footsteps go quiet. (Quiet Step added to your wrist band; wear it from the band menu.)

title: Panel behind the machines
solvedText: The wall that is not a wall slides back. Warm air, the smell of tea, and somebody arguing with a radio.

title: Service door controller
solvedText: Relay restored. The service door unlocks.

title: Pallas's maintenance log
solvedText: The log decrypts. Entry after entry is signed ALD, in a hand that is not Pallas's.
